name: CampusLoanTracker
tagline: Library and device loans, renewals, holds and fines – for the circulation desk and student self-service.
description: An advanced PCF code component for campus lending: laptops, calculators, media kits, course reserves, study-room keys and library books. Policy-driven renewals, barcode scan-to-check-in with hold-shelf routing, holds queues with pickup windows, a fines ledger with payments and waivers, and a patron view for Power Pages portals.
features: Search, filter and sort loans with colour-coded due status
Policy-driven renewals with hold, fine-threshold and blocked-account checks; bulk renew
Barcode scan to check in or renew; hold-shelf routing
Overdue fines with grace days, daily rate and cap; mark lost with replacement fees
Holds queue: pickup windows, expire and promote, check out to borrower
Fines ledger with payments and waivers
Phone layout with bottom-sheet details; keyboard and screen-reader support
Outputs for every action and a browser event for Power Pages
